aboutBody: Happy Village Landscaping is a North York-based crew that designs, builds and renovates properties across Toronto and the GTA. If you've been juggling a landscaper for the yard, a contractor for the basement and someone else for the walkway, you can stop — we handle landscape design, hardscaping, sod and irrigation, basement finishing, kitchen and bath remodeling, and commercial work under one roof.

Founder Abdul Azem built the company around one rule: the person who quotes your job answers for your job. He still walks quotes personally, still checks base grades and framing himself, and still picks up the phone — because a local business lives or dies on whether its name means something on the street where it works.

Every project starts with a free on-site quote and a detailed written scope, so you know exactly what's included and what it costs before we lift a shovel or swing a hammer. When you call +1 (438) 835-4350 — any hour, we're open 24 hours — you reach the people who actually show up and do the work.

Whether it's a new stone patio in North York, a finished basement in Scarborough or year-round grounds maintenance for a commercial property in Markham, we bring the same standard: clean work, honest pricing and a property you're proud of.

home.locationsBody: We're based in North York and work across the region — Toronto, Scarborough, Etobicoke, York, East York, Vaughan and Markham included. If you're in our service area, the on-site quote is always free.

faqs.a: We serve North York, Toronto, Scarborough, Etobicoke, York, East York, Vaughan and Markham from our base at 25 Stubbs Dr in North York. Because we're local, most of the GTA is a short drive — which means faster start times and quick follow-ups.

Yes — every project starts with a free, no-obligation on-site quote. We visit your property, take measurements, discuss options and give you a detailed written, itemized price before any work begins. There is never a charge for the quote itself.

faqs.q: Can one crew really handle both my yard and my basement?
faqs.a: That's exactly what we're set up for. We do landscape design, hardscaping, sod, irrigation and lawn care outdoors, and basement finishing, kitchen and bath remodeling, flooring, drywall and painting indoors. One quote, one schedule, one crew — instead of three contractors to coordinate.

faqs.q: Are you open outside business hours?
faqs.a: Our phone line is open 24 hours — call +1 (438) 835-4350 any time, including evenings, weekends and storm nights. Site work runs on scheduled hours, but you'll always reach us when you call.

It depends on the season and the scope. Smaller jobs like sod, garden beds or a walkway can often be scheduled within days to a couple of weeks; larger design-build and renovation projects are booked in the order quotes are approved. Call us and we'll give you a realistic timeline for your project.

faqs.q: Do you take on commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle commercial landscape design, ongoing commercial property maintenance and winter snow removal for businesses and property managers across the GTA — with written programs, service records and one accountable contact.

faqs.q: Do you provide snow removal in the winter?
faqs.a: We do — snow removal is one of our seasonal services for both residential and commercial clients. Many of our landscaping customers keep us on through the winter for plowing and clearing, so the same local crew takes care of their property year-round.

story: Happy Village Landscaping was founded by Abdul Azem, a hands-on contractor who learned this work the way it's supposed to be learned: on real job sites, on the tools, across Toronto and the GTA. Based at 25 Stubbs Dr in North York, the company was built around a frustration Abdul kept hearing from homeowners — why does fixing one property take three different contractors, three schedules and three excuses?

His answer became the whole business: one accountable, founder-led crew that handles your entire property, outdoors and indoors, all year. Abdul still leads quotes personally — from the first site walk to the final walkthrough — and still answers for the work himself. When you hire Happy Village Landscaping, the person who quotes your job is the person responsible for your job.

Being North York-based matters. It's where we live and where our reputation travels fastest. That's why every project starts with a free on-site visit, a detailed written scope and itemized pricing — and why we walk the finished work with you before we call it complete. We won't pretend to be the biggest contractor in the GTA. We're a working local crew with a standard Abdul holds every project to: do it right, price it honestly, and stand behind it.

about.differenceTitle: What Makes Us Different From Other GTA Contractors
difference: Plenty of companies do landscaping, and plenty do renovations — very few do both with one accountable crew. Because we work indoors and outdoors, we can sequence projects the way homeowners actually need them: the yard graded and sodded while the basement is being finished, or a stone walkway poured while the kitchen is drying. You get one point of contact, one schedule and one written scope covering everything.

Just as importantly, we quote in writing before we start. No vague allowances, no mid-project surprises, no subcontractor roulette. When you call +1 (438) 835-4350, you talk to people who will actually be standing on your property — and who answer for the finished result.
about.where: We're headquartered at 25 Stubbs Dr in North York and serve the Greater Toronto Area: Toronto, Scarborough, Etobicoke, York, East York, Vaughan and Markham. Our free on-site quotes cover all eight communities, and because we're local, travel time is never an excuse — or a surcharge. When you work with Happy Village Landscaping, you work directly with the crew — not a sales rep and not a rotating cast of subcontractors.
